text: {"status":"answered","answer":"Under the Share Certificate Account Disclosure (version DEP-DSC-017), for certificates with terms longer than 12 months, the early withdrawal penalty is equal to 180 days of dividends, calculated on the amount withdrawn at the dividend rate in effect on the certificate. This penalty may reduce principal if dividends earned are less than the penalty amount. It is waived if the withdrawal is due to the owner's death or a court declaration of legal incompetence.","cited_chunk_ids":["share_certificate_disclosure::layout::B_structure::0004"],"reason":"The passage directly states the penalty for certificates with terms longer than 12 months."}
